models.pair: Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B against Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct. Same tokenizer and the same token ids at every position.

definitions.overlap: Macro overlap = 100 × (0.40 × top-1 agreement + 0.25 × soft-or-better rate + 0.35 × mean linear CKA). Soft-or-better counts identical top-1 and top-5 overlap.
definitions.buckets: Identical: same top-1 next token. Soft parity: top-1 differs but the top-5 sets intersect. Hard conflict: the top-5 sets are disjoint. The three rates sum to 100%.
definitions.jsd: At each position, symmetric Jensen-Shannon divergence (bits) is computed on the union of the two top-K supports plus a residual OTHER bin. Divergence power is JSD squared. J(k) is the EMA of that power.
definitions.threshold: μ and σ are seeded with a robust estimate (median and MAD) on positions where top-1 agrees, then a slow EMA updates them only while the stream is unflagged. A position opens a span when power exceeds μ + 3σ and an absolute floor of (0.08 bits)². The span stays open until power falls under μ + σ.
definitions.kinds: Lost / forgotten: A's normalized entropy ≤ 0.22 and B's ≥ 0.30. Acquired: B ≤ 0.22 and A ≥ 0.30. Conflict: both ≤ 0.22 and the top-1 tokens differ. Drift: flagged, but neither certainty pattern. Normalized entropy is H / ln(vocab).
definitions.cka: Linear CKA compares column-centered hidden states with the Gram form of HSIC. It is invariant to orthogonal rotation and isotropic scaling.
definitions.residual: Unlearnable residual fraction = held-out Var(h_B − h_A W) / Var(h_B). W is refit on complementary token folds so a wide layer cannot interpolate. In-sample residual is also logged. λ = 0.05 · tr(XᵀX) / width. The pie uses shared = mean predictive R², A-unique = 1 − R²(B→A), B-unique = 1 − R²(A→B), normalized to 100%.
